outcome: Prevalence of ultrasonography signs of AIP at different gestational ages
cohort: Pregnant women with a prenatal diagnosis of AIP confirmed at delivery at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Arnas Civico Hospital, Palermo, Italy, between January 1, 2007, and April 30, 2017 (n=105)
finding: The prevalence of ultrasonography signs suggestive of AIP increased significantly from the early first trimester onwards, with most classical signs present in a majority of patients by 11-14 weeks of gestation.
mod_finding: This study on abnormally invasive placenta noted that indicators of this condition during the early first trimester were similar to those of a cesarean scar pregnancy.
